pages.text: Before kettles and distilleries, most witches learn the cauldron. Anointing Paste is what wakes an ordinary cauldron into a Witch's Cauldron.$(br2)It is one of the earliest real progression gates in the craft, because so many foundational reagents begin there.
Blend Belladonna, Mandrake Root, Water Artichoke Globe, and Snowbell to make four paste. Keep some in reserve. You will come back to the cauldron often.

Place a vanilla cauldron in the world and apply the paste directly to it. The Witch's Cauldron then needs a roaring fire beneath it and water in the bowl.$(br2)From there come the older cauldron workings and humble reagents the rest of Witchery depends on. Mutandis itself is compounded separately by hand and is covered in its own entry.
